data.name: Idle Deathworks
data.detailed_description:
Idle Deathworks is an idle tower defense roguelite where the enemies trying to kill you are also the engine of your economy.

Summon monsters to generate resources. Use their remains to expand the path, construct towers, and strengthen your defenses. The more pressure you create, the faster you can grow—but one greedy decision can end your run.

THE HORDE IS YOUR INCOME

Enemies do not simply arrive to be survived. You choose what to summon and how aggressively to summon it.

Send manageable groups for steady progress or flood the path to accelerate your earnings. Stronger monsters offer new opportunities, but every additional creature increases the chance of breaking your defense.

BUILD, UPGRADE, AND ADAPT

Place towers, upgrade their attacks, and expand your build area.

Every run develops differently as you decide where to invest limited resources. Strengthen your existing defense, unlock new monsters and towers, or extend the path to create more time for your towers to attack.

LET IT RUN—OR PUSH IT HARDER

Automatic waves keep combat and progression moving while your defenses do their work.

Return to collect resources, improve your setup, and summon additional enemies whenever you want to accelerate the run. Active play creates opportunities for faster growth—but also gives you more ways to die.

RISK THE QUEST TILES

Dangerous quest tiles are scattered throughout the world. Each contains a challenge and a reward.

Prepare your defense, accept the quest, and survive the challenge. Every completed level makes the next attempt more dangerous and more rewarding.

DEATH IS PART OF THE BUILD

Eventually, the horde will break through.

Resurrect and spend the permanent currency earned from milestones and quest challenges. Gain additional lives, improve your towers, accelerate summoning, strengthen resource harvesting, and unlock new ways to shape future runs.

Each death shortens the climb you have already conquered—and gives you the power to push into something worse.

HOW GREEDY CAN YOUR DEFENSE AFFORD TO BE?

Idle Deathworks is built around the tension between safety and acceleration.

Summon slowly and survive.

Summon aggressively and grow.

Push too far, die, resurrect—and build a better death machine.
